projects.title: Dr. Nano
projects.description: Dr, Nano was the product of my team's first Global Game Jam. We had 48 hours to design a game from concept to final release. I'm glad to say that we completed the game, albeit not to the detail that I would have liked, but it was completed. In those 48 hours, my team had to teach ourselves how to do spritework, how to do animation, and we had to learn how to use the Gamemaker Engine.
